talk.jaymoskingdoms.camp_alarm.run.0: To the fire! We're set on!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.camp_alarm.run.1: Blood on the edge! Sound the horn!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.camp_alarm.run.2: Foes in the camp! Up, up!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.camp_alarm.run.3: They're on us! To the horn!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.camp_alarm.run.5: Get the horn! Get the horn!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.camp_alarm.horn.0: To arms! All of you, to arms!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.camp_alarm.horn.2: Up! Find them and gut them!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.camp_alarm.horn.3: The camp's struck! Every hand to the fight!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.camp_alarm.horn.5: Guard the fire! Walk the ring!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.camp_alarm.calm.1: They're gone. Keep an eye out.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.camp_alarm.calm.2: Nothing left out there. Stand down.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.camp_alarm.calm.3: That's the end of them. Back to work.
